say: Rule one, hierarchy. Before you open Canva, write your message in three levels. The hook, like Fresh Zobo, 500 naira. The support, like Chilled, no preservatives. And the action, your WhatsApp number. The hook is biggest. The action is small but clear.

cards.d: Decide what is read first. One big hook, a medium support block, a small action.
Text must stand out from its background. If it blurs when you squint, fix it.
Line every item up with an edge or the centre. Pick one alignment and stick to it.

say: Rule two, contrast. Yellow text on white disappears on a phone screen, especially in sunlight. Squint at your design. If the words blur into the background, the contrast is too low.

cards.d: Decide what is read first. One big hook, a medium support block, a small action.
Text must stand out from its background. If it blurs when you squint, fix it.
Line every item up with an edge or the centre. Pick one alignment and stick to it.

say: Rule three, alignment. Randomly placed text looks amateur. Pick one alignment, and use the guide lines Canva shows you.

say: For example, Bisi in Ibadan made a flyer for her women's group meeting. Seven lines of text in four fonts, a full photo background, and the date hidden at the bottom in small yellow letters.

say: She wrote her three levels, moved the extra lines into the WhatsApp caption, and used two fonts. A dark green rectangle at 80% transparency over the photo makes white text stand out.
Her sister saw it for three seconds and could repeat the name and date.

say: Here is a worked example. Halima sells fabrics in Kano. She chooses Instagram Post and searches the templates for price list.

say: She types her new prices: 6 yards for 9,000 naira, 12 yards for 17,500 naira, and a half piece for 4,800 naira. These prices are approximate.
She sets the background to her brand colour, makes the text white for contrast, and drops in a photo of her best selling fabric.

say: To work faster, set brand colours early so they stay one tap away. Duplicate your master templates and change only the words and photo.
When you resize, say from a 1080 by 1350 post to a 1080 by 1920 story, check for text cut off at the edges. Name designs and use folders.

say: To remember. One hook, one support, one action. Strong contrast. A small palette with HEX codes and two fonts. The right size from the start. And reuse your master templates.

panel.heading: Remember
items: One hook, one support block, one action
Strong contrast; squint to test it
3 to 5 colours with HEX codes, 2 fonts
Start at the right size; crown means Pro
Reuse master templates; check every resize
